exit_criterion: Demonstrated over HTTP by tests/exit_run_phase6.py and recorded in docs/phase-6/exit-run.md. (1) On the raw Quadram meat set (120 spectra, both runs of each sample kept, grouped by sample): grouped cross-validation keeps every pair together; PLS-DA's grouped cross-validated accuracy, its permutation p-value and its all-sample final model each match their references (scikit-learn on the served folds, permutation_test_score); a VIP-selected model's nested outer error is reported and matches a reference rebuild; SVM's cross-validated accuracy matches scikit-learn SVC; the final model exported as JSON and as the Python snippet reproduces application predictions. (2) On Tecator, PLS's final model and its bootstrap intervals match a reference.
decisions: 2026-10-05. Phase 6 is validation integrity: the numbers a user reports must be right before more methods are added. Grouped splits, a final all-sample model, nested selection, permutation tests and bootstrap intervals come first.
2026-10-05. The model saved and exported below a split is refitted on every sample, with every fitted step above it; fold zero's model stays only as the held-out view.
2026-10-05. SVM joins Phase 6, hand-written (SMO). Genetic-algorithm selection, the plugin API, self-hosted mode, an ASD splice step, zips of single-spectrum SPC files and MATLAB v7.3 stay post-1.0.
2026-10-05. Signed packages are in the phase but not in its exit criterion: they need certificates the maintainer has to obtain, and the feature is blocked until then.
2026-10-05. Unchanged: scikit-learn and chemotools stay development dependencies; every kernel is hand-written. One release, v1.2.0, at the end of the phase.
2026-10-05. Read each feature's GitHub issue, not only this list, before calling it done: Phase 5's exit run missed part of #289's criterion because the two had drifted.
